summary: Reproduced that ResponsesRequest discarded both routed_dp_rank and deprecated data_parallel_rank, then added the rank fields, deprecated-field migration, header-over-body resolution, and forwarding to initial and built-in-tool continuation GenerateReqInput objects.

tests.what_was_measured: Base-state reproduction showed routed_dp_rank=3 and data_parallel_rank=4 were both absent from the parsed ResponsesRequest model dump; raw output is reports/j-8efde798bc05/raw/failing-before-schema.txt.

61 tests and 2 subtests passed, including request schema preservation, deprecated rank migration and precedence, body-to-GenerateReqInput forwarding, X-Data-Parallel-Rank header precedence, and the no-rank boundary. Raw output is reports/j-8efde798bc05/raw/focused-tests-final.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and correction are confined to Pydantic request parsing and CPU-side OpenAI serving adaptation; no GPU kernel, model execution, or numerical output is involved, so a GPU smoke would not validate the reported routing propagation bug.

remaining_limitations: No multi-rank DP server was launched and no model weights were used; validation covers the deterministic request parsing and serving adapter boundary through the GenerateReqInput handed toward the scheduler.
The test fixture does not claim full model inference, distributed scheduling, or multi-node validation.
